editorial:
Imagine the happiest day of your life turning into a total nightmare in a matter of seconds. That is exactly what happens to Iris. She just had her first baby, but instead of sweet moments, she gets a brutal confession. Her partner, Pieter, drops a bombshell: he never wanted the kid, he has been cheating for a year, and he is moving to Africa with his other woman. It is a wild, stressful, and strangely funny ride that explores how quickly your world can flip upside down when the person you trust most turns out to be a stranger.

The acting feels very real, making you feel every bit of Iris's shock and anger. While the plot moves at a steady clip, some parts might feel a bit heavy, but the dark humor keeps it from being too depressing. You will find yourself rooting for Iris to find her strength while hating Pieter with a passion. If you are in the mood for a gritty family drama, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the end, Iris has to face the reality that her old life is gone forever. After the chaos of Pieter's betrayal and his attempt to leave, Iris finds the inner strength to move forward as a single mother. She stops trying to fix a broken relationship and focuses on her baby. The movie wraps up with her finding peace and independence, showing that she is much stronger than Pieter ever gave her credit for.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about betrayal and personal strength.
